services.name: Party package
services.desc: Wave Street Studios is a hidden gem on the Recreation Trail above historic Cannery Row, just steps from McAbee Beach and the Monterey Bay Aquarium. This eco-modern venue offers a broadcast studio, concert hall, and private event space for up to 150 guests. With a 1,000 sq. ft. sprung dance floor, studio sound system, and live-streaming capabilities, it's perfect for weddings, receptions, meetings, and celebrations. Designed for all-weather use, the space features a waterfall, heated bench, succulent gardens, granite rock walls, and copper-clad doors. services.name: Venue Tour
services.desc: Discover the unique charm of Wave Street Studios with a personalized venue tour. Walk through our eco-modern indoor and outdoor spaces, explore the garden courtyard, and envision your event in our thoughtfully designed setting. Our team will guide you through the venue’s features, including the grand staircase entrance, radiantly heated seating, stunning architectural details, and state-of-the-art audio/video capabilities. Whether you're planning a wedding, private event, or live performance, we’ll help you see how Wave Street Studios can bring your vision to life. At Wave Street Studios, we are excited to offer personalized venue tours to help you envision your event in our unique space.
